Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production background texture for an interactive Chinese xiangqi board, portrait aspect ratio 9:10, high resolution.
Primary request: an exceptionally refined, visually striking "Obsidian Star River" Chinese fantasy strategy board. Strict flat orthographic view from directly above, no perspective at all. A full-bleed near-black blue obsidian stone slab with subtle deep teal marbling and sparse pinprick gold mineral flecks. The middle horizontal band, between 45% and 55% of image height, contains a delicate ethereal turquoise and warm golden mist river, quiet luminous currents, thin filaments like a distant galaxy. Extremely subtle engraved Chinese cloud and dragon-scale motifs only around the extreme outer 3% perimeter, fine antique gold inlay, exquisite luxury game craftsmanship. All of the playing area inside the outer 4% must remain calm and mostly uniform dark stone so a programmatic gold playing grid and circular pieces remain clearly readable.
Lighting/mood: cinematic restrained glow, polished yet matte enough to read gameplay, sophisticated wuxia artifact, finely detailed premium game material.
Constraints: NO chess pieces, NO grid lines, NO squares, NO circles, NO characters, NO letters, NO text, NO logo, NO watermark. Do not draw a complete board diagram. No large dragon illustration. No raised frame occupying the playing area. No bright cloudy areas or distracting stars. Texture extends to every edge.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single game-ready circular Chinese xiangqi piece base sprite, no glyph, square canvas, genuinely transparent alpha background.
Primary request: exquisite "Obsidian Star River" red faction xiangqi medallion, strict perfectly circular flat orthographic top-down view, centered, symmetric, no tilt, no perspective. The circular disk occupies 92% of the square image. Deep garnet red translucent enamel/obsidian central face, mostly uniform and empty in the central 64% diameter to receive a clear Chinese character at runtime. Two delicate concentric antique gold metal rims, elaborately micro-engraved Chinese cloud motifs only in the outer annular border; subtle vermilion light inset into the rim, tiny warm gold highlights, fine physical bevel for depth, premium handcrafted imperial artifact. Restrained ember aura immediately against the outer edge, crisp silhouette. Sophisticated finely detailed AAA game sprite, realistic PBR mineral and metal material, top-left studio light, legible at small size.
Constraints: one disk only, NO Chinese characters, NO letters, NO writing, NO emblem in the center, NO scene, NO board, NO pedestal, NO floor. Center must remain empty and dark red. Background must have true transparency, not checkerboard pixels. Keep all geometry inside canvas, no broad drop shadow.
